name: The Infinite Fields
source:
You've always been drawn to places where the veil is thin.

But this is the first time you've ever met someone there.

Or, rather, some thing.

[From [url=https://knightanni.itch.io/the-infinite-fields]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你总是会被面纱薄弱的地方所吸引。

但这是你第一次在那里见到人。

或者更确切地说，某种东西。

[来自[url=https://knightanni.itch.io/the-infinite-fields]itch.io[/url]]
